themes.headline: Payments account for 40% of reviews, with a high volume of concerns
Onboarding issues make up 30.2% of reviews, with users facing difficulties
Statements and portfolio issues comprise 24.9% of reviews, with data accuracy concerns

quotes.paraphrased: Users are experiencing high fees and glitches during transactions
Users are struggling with the onboarding process, citing slow app performance and login issues
Users are reporting discrepancies in their portfolio statements and charts

actions.text: Improve payment processing to reduce errors and fees
Optimize the onboarding process to reduce friction and improve user experience
Enhance data accuracy and syncing to provide reliable portfolio statements
